_description: Vulnerability allowlist for pnpm audit. Each entry documents a known vulnerability that has been reviewed and accepted with justification.

allowlist.justification: Transitive dependency of @prisma/dev (Prisma CLI tooling). Not used in application code — hono's serveStatic middleware is not invoked. Prisma 7.8.0 pins @prisma/dev@0.24.3 which pins @hono/node-server@1.19.11. Fix requires Prisma to release an update.

React Router: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Invocation. Affects >=7.12.0 <8.3.0; NO PATCHED VERSION EXISTS — react-router-dom's latest published release is 7.18.1 and no 8.x has shipped, so there is nothing to upgrade to. Not reachable in this application: the frontend is a client-only Vite SPA using BrowserRouter (app/frontend/src/App.tsx), built with `tsc && vite build` to static assets and served by Caddy. React Server Components mode is not enabled, vite.config.ts declares no ssr/rsc target, and no server-side router API (createStaticHandler, StaticRouter, ServerRouter, renderToPipeableStream) is imported anywhere in src/. The vulnerable code path requires RSC mode to be active. Downgrading below 7.12.0 to escape the advisory range is not viable: it would reintroduce four advisories patched only at >=7.18.0, including a high-severity unauthenticated DoS. Re-evaluate when react-router 8.3.0 is published.

Transitive dependency of dev/build tooling. Not used in application production code. Crafted ZIP file triggers 4GB memory allocation — only exploitable if parsing untrusted ZIP input, which this app does not do.
Transitive dependency via glob/minimatch in dev tooling. Not used with untrusted input in production. DoS via exponential-time expansion requires attacker-controlled brace patterns.
Transitive dependency via glob/minimatch in dev tooling. Not used with untrusted input in production. DoS via unbounded expansion length.
Transitive dependency via glob/minimatch in dev tooling. Not used with untrusted input in production. DoS bypass of CVE-2026-14257 mitigation.
Transitive dependency of dev tooling (jest, eslint configs). Not used to parse untrusted YAML in production. YAML merge-key chains can force quadratic CPU consumption.
Transitive dependency of npm/node-gyp in native module builds. Not used to decompress untrusted archives in production. Decompression/parse DoS via unlimited input.
Transitive dependency of npm/node-gyp in native module builds. Not used to decompress untrusted archives in production. Negative entry size causes infinite loop.

Transitive dependency of ajv (JSON schema validation). fast-uri host confusion via literal backslash — not exploitable in this app because URI inputs come from validated user data, not raw untrusted URI strings.
Transitive dependency of ajv (JSON schema validation). fast-uri host confusion via failed IDN canonicalization — not exploitable in this app as URI inputs are validated.
